steps.instructions: Write solution.py in the supplied candidate directory with slugify(text): lowercase, remove punctuation, collapse whitespace to hyphens, trim leading/trailing hyphens. Return an empty string for empty/punctuation-only input. No imports with side effects, no source/evaluator edits. Use validation feedback to repair the candidate.

validator.command: python3 -c 'import os,runpy; f=runpy.run_path(os.path.join(os.environ["WORKFLOW_CANDIDATE"],"solution.py"))["slugify"]; assert f("  Hello, World!  ")=="hello-world"; assert f("a   b")=="a-b"; assert f("!!!")==""; assert f("")==""'
